subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: Should OpenClaw preserve prior-session context after provider-error abort/takeover, or keep recovery limited to resend guidance and explicit reset replay?
rationale: The source supports the takeover path, but automatic context carry-forward can expose previous transcript content across security and routing boundaries if the intended product boundary is not explicit.

options.title: Bounded context bridge
options.body: Approve a narrowly scoped previous-session context bridge for provider-error takeover recovery with auth, channel, thread, and clean-reset guards plus regression coverage.

options.title: Resend-only recovery
options.body: Limit the fix to clear user guidance and retry/fallback behavior, leaving automatic transcript carry-forward out of runtime recovery.

options.title: Explicit reset replay only
options.body: Keep context replay tied to the existing reset lifecycle and close or narrow takeover-context requests after the related PR is resolved.

recommendation.title: Bounded context bridge
recommendation.body: Approve a narrowly scoped previous-session context bridge for provider-error takeover recovery with auth, channel, thread, and clean-reset guards plus regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The open related PR is the current implementation candidate touching the same takeover recovery path.
